name: anonymous-enumeration-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): opens anonymous enumeration by setting HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa RestrictAnonymous AND RestrictAnonymousSAM to 0 -- unauthenticated sessions can list accounts and shares for later targeting. The hardened state is both values at 1. Secedit/policy-managed: harden via Local Security Policy (Network access) so a policy refresh does not revert a bare reg write. Vars: none. Pairs with a powershell_json check over both values. Idempotent.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name RestrictAnonymous -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name RestrictAnonymousSAM -Value 0 -Type DWord
Write-Output 'RestrictAnonymous(=SAM)=0 set'
